01-01.title: all praise
01-01.line: all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds.
01-01.meaning: the second line of al-Fatiha, said in every prayer. thanks before anything else.

01-02.title: intentions
01-02.meaning: the first hadith in Bukhari's collection. before you start today, ask: why am i doing this?

01-03.title: bismillah
01-03.line: in the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
01-03.meaning: said before eating, driving, starting work. it opens 113 of the 114 surahs.

01-04.title: you alone
01-04.line: you alone we worship, and you alone we ask for help.
01-04.meaning: seventeen times a day in the daily prayers, a Muslim says this. help is always asked for, never assumed.

01-05.title: good in both
01-05.original: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
01-05.line: our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the hereafter.
01-05.meaning: the most common du'a of the Prophet ﷺ, often said between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone.

01-06.title: Ar-Rahman
01-06.meaning: Allah's mercy that reaches everyone, everywhere. it opens almost every surah.

01-07.title: as if you see him
01-07.line: worship Allah as though you see him; and if you do not see him, he sees you.
01-07.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's description of ihsan, excellence in faith.

01-08.title: the straight path
01-08.line: guide us along the straight path.
01-08.meaning: the heart of al-Fatiha is a request for guidance. it's a prayer for every crossroads.

01-09.title: alhamdulillah
01-09.line: alhamdulillah: all praise is for Allah.
01-09.meaning: the answer to 'how are you?' in good times and hard ones.

01-10.title: remember me
01-10.line: remember me, and i will remember you.
01-10.meaning: a two-way promise. a single moment of remembrance is answered.

01-11.title: the heart
01-11.line: there is a piece of flesh in the body: if it is sound, all is sound.
01-11.meaning: that piece of flesh is the heart. care for it, and the rest follows.

01-12.title: patience and prayer
01-12.line: seek help through patience and prayer; Allah is with those who are patient.
01-12.meaning: when the day gets heavy, these are the two handholds.

01-13.title: more knowledge
01-13.line: my Lord, increase me in knowledge.
01-13.meaning: a short du'a the Prophet ﷺ was told to make. good before any lesson.

01-14.title: subhanallah
01-14.meaning: said in wonder: at a sunset, a baby, a kindness.

01-15.title: Ar-Rahim
01-15.meaning: mercy that is close and personal. Allah's care for you, specifically.

01-16.title: sincerity
01-16.meaning: nasiha means sincere goodwill: to Allah, his book, his Messenger, leaders, and everyone.

01-17.title: we return
01-17.line: to Allah we belong, and to him we return.
01-17.meaning: said at any loss, big or small. it holds grief gently.

01-18.title: allahu akbar
01-18.meaning: greater than any worry, any fear, any problem.

01-19.title: i am near
01-19.line: when my servants ask about me, i am near; i answer the one who calls.
01-19.meaning: no middleman needed. one honest call is heard.

01-20.title: as much as you can
01-20.line: what i command you, do as much of it as you can.
01-20.meaning: faith asks for your best, not the impossible.

01-21.title: never asleep
01-21.line: neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes him.
01-21.meaning: from Ayat al-Kursi. you can rest tonight; the One who never sleeps is keeping watch.

01-22.title: open my chest
01-22.original: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
01-22.line: my Lord, open my chest for me and ease my task for me.
01-22.meaning: Musa's prayer before a hard conversation.

01-23.title: only good
01-23.line: Allah is good and accepts only what is good.
01-23.meaning: good earnings, good food, good intentions.

01-24.title: As-Salam
01-24.meaning: peace isn't just something Allah gives. it's one of his names.

01-25.title: la ilaha illallah
01-25.line: there is no god but Allah.
01-25.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ called it the best remembrance.

01-26.title: seven ears of grain
01-26.line: charity is like a grain that grows seven ears, each with a hundred grains.
01-26.meaning: small giving multiplies in ways you can't see.

01-27.title: a kind word
01-27.line: a kind word and forgiveness are better than charity followed by hurt.
01-27.meaning: how you give matters as much as what you give.

01-28.title: leave the doubtful
01-28.line: leave what makes you doubt for what does not.
01-28.meaning: when you're unsure, choose the clearer path.

01-29.title: astaghfirullah
01-29.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ said it more than seventy times a day.

01-30.title: within your capacity
01-30.line: Allah does not burden any soul beyond what it can bear.
01-30.meaning: whatever you're carrying today, you were made able to carry it.

01-31.title: from the whale
01-31.original: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
01-31.line: there is no god but you; glory be to you; i was among the wrongdoers.
01-31.meaning: Yunus prayed this in the dark. the Prophet ﷺ said no one in distress prays it without being answered.

02-01.title: none of your business
02-01.line: part of a person's good Islam is leaving what does not concern them.
02-01.meaning: one less thing to worry about today: other people's business.

02-03.title: what goodness really is
02-03.line: goodness is not facing east or west, but giving and keeping faith.
02-03.meaning: the verse lists real righteousness: belief, generosity, prayer, keeping promises, patience in hardship.

02-04.title: as-salamu alaykum
02-04.meaning: the greeting of the believers, and of paradise. answer with 'wa alaykum as-salam.'

02-05.title: love for your brother
02-05.line: none of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
02-05.meaning: wish someone else the good you want for you.

02-06.title: wherever you turn
02-06.line: to Allah belong the east and the west; wherever you turn, there is the face of Allah.
02-06.meaning: no corner of the world is far from Allah.

02-07.title: maybe it's good
02-07.line: you may dislike something that is good for you.
02-07.meaning: not every closed door is a loss. some are protection.

02-08.title: we wronged ourselves
02-08.line: our Lord, we have wronged ourselves; if you don't forgive us and have mercy, we are lost.
02-08.meaning: Adam and Hawwa's prayer. the first du'a of repentance.

02-09.title: jazakallahu khayran
02-09.line: may Allah reward you with good.
02-09.meaning: a thank-you that hands the reward to Allah.

02-10.title: good or silent
02-10.line: whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or stay silent.
02-10.meaning: when unsure what to say, silence is a good choice too.

02-11.title: ease, not hardship
02-11.line: Allah wants ease for you, not hardship.
02-11.meaning: said about fasting, and true for the whole faith. there's mercy in the rules.

02-12.title: Al-Mu'min
02-12.meaning: the same root as faith and safety: amn. faith and feeling safe are linked.

02-13.title: don't be angry
02-13.line: a man asked for advice. the Prophet ﷺ said: do not become angry.
02-13.meaning: he asked again and again; the answer stayed the same.

02-14.title: what you love
02-14.line: you will not reach true goodness until you give from what you love.
02-14.meaning: give something that actually means something to you.

02-15.title: masha'Allah
02-15.meaning: said when admiring something, so the praise goes to the right place.

02-16.title: not to burden you
02-16.line: we did not send down the Qur'an to make you miserable.
02-16.meaning: the opening of Surah Ta-Ha. faith is meant to lift you, not weigh you down.

02-17.title: the rope
02-17.line: hold firmly together to the rope of Allah, and do not be divided.
02-17.meaning: faith is a rope held by many hands at once.

02-18.title: keep our hearts steady
02-18.line: our Lord, do not let our hearts swerve after you have guided us.

02-19.title: excellence in everything
02-19.line: Allah has prescribed excellence in all things.

02-20.title: the five prayers
02-20.line: five prayers, like a river by your door you wash in five times a day.
02-20.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's picture of the daily prayers.

02-21.title: swallow the anger
02-21.line: those who hold back anger and pardon people; Allah loves those who do good.
02-21.meaning: pardoning isn't weakness. it's what Allah loves.

02-22.title: Al-Khaliq
02-22.meaning: he makes everything from nothing. look at one created thing today.

02-23.title: follow with good
02-23.line: follow a bad deed with a good one, and treat people with good character.
02-23.meaning: a slip is followed by a fresh start.

02-24.title: don't lose heart
02-24.line: do not lose heart and do not grieve.
02-24.meaning: a verse given after a hard day for the early Muslims. keep going.

02-25.title: wudu
02-25.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ said small sins fall away with the water.

02-26.title: gentle heart
02-26.line: by Allah's mercy you were gentle with them; had you been harsh, they would have left you.
02-26.meaning: said to the Prophet ﷺ. gentleness keeps people close.

02-27.title: coolness of eyes
02-27.line: our Lord, grant us spouses and children who are the comfort of our eyes.
02-27.meaning: a prayer for a loving home.

02-28.title: be mindful
02-28.line: be mindful of Allah, and you will find him before you.
02-28.meaning: told to the young Ibn Abbas. closeness grows from remembering.

02-29.title: enough for us
02-29.line: Allah is enough for us, and he is the best to rely on.
02-29.meaning: said by believers when told to be afraid. a calm answer to fear.

03-01.title: fajr
03-01.line: the two rak'ahs before fajr are better than the world and all in it.
03-01.meaning: the dawn prayer is a gift to start the day.

03-02.title: Al-Ghaffar
03-02.meaning: forgiving again and again, not just once.

03-03.title: the pens are lifted
03-03.line: if the whole world gathered to help you, it could only help with what Allah has written.
03-03.meaning: a teaching that frees you from fearing people too much.

03-04.title: signs in the sky
03-04.line: in the heavens and the earth, and night and day, are signs for those who reflect.
03-04.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ would look at the night sky and recite this.

03-05.title: standing, sitting, lying
03-05.line: those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides.
03-05.meaning: remembrance fits any posture, any moment.

03-06.title: for parents
03-06.line: my Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when i was small.
03-06.meaning: a du'a to say for your parents, living or passed.

03-07.title: modesty
03-07.line: if you feel no shame, then do as you wish.
03-07.meaning: a gentle warning: a sense of modesty keeps us good.

03-08.title: the adhan
03-08.line: Bilal's voice was chosen for the first call to prayer.
03-08.meaning: a freed man from Abyssinia, the first muezzin of Islam.

03-09.title: from one soul
03-09.line: Allah created you from a single soul.
03-09.meaning: every person you meet today comes from the same beginning.

03-10.title: then stand firm
03-10.line: say 'i believe in Allah,' and then be steadfast.
03-10.meaning: the shortest advice the Prophet ﷺ gave: believe, then keep at it.

03-11.title: Al-Wahhab
03-11.meaning: he gives freely, without being asked and without needing anything back.

03-12.title: be good to neighbors
03-12.line: be good to parents, relatives, orphans, the needy, near neighbors and far neighbors.
03-12.meaning: a whole circle of kindness, from home outward.

03-13.title: rest in prayer
03-13.line: o Bilal, give us rest with it.
03-13.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ found rest in prayer, not from it.

03-14.title: a better greeting
03-14.line: when you are greeted, return it with a better greeting, or at least the same.
03-14.meaning: answer salam with a little extra warmth.

03-15.title: mercy from you
03-15.line: our Lord, give us mercy from yourself and set right our affair.
03-15.meaning: the prayer of the young people in the cave.

03-16.title: fills the scale
03-16.line: purity is half of faith, and 'alhamdulillah' fills the scale.
03-16.meaning: two words that weigh more than they seem.

03-17.title: the coolness of my eyes
03-17.line: the coolness of my eyes is in prayer.
03-17.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's joy was in salah.

03-18.title: stand for justice
03-18.line: stand firm for justice, even against yourselves.
03-18.meaning: honesty starts with how we treat our own mistakes.

03-19.title: forbidden to myself
03-19.line: o my servants, i have forbidden injustice for myself, so do not wrong one another.
03-19.meaning: Allah speaks of his own justice, and asks the same of us.

03-20.title: Ar-Razzaq
03-20.meaning: every meal, every paycheck, every breath is provision.

03-21.title: help one another
03-21.line: help one another in goodness and mindfulness of Allah.

03-22.title: sadaqah
03-22.line: sadaqah: charity, from the word for truthfulness.

03-23.title: one life
03-23.line: whoever saves one life, it is as if they saved all of humanity.
03-23.meaning: every single person carries the weight of the whole world.

03-24.title: don't burden us
03-24.line: our Lord, do not place on us a burden beyond what we can bear.
03-24.meaning: from the last verses of al-Baqarah, recited by many each night.

03-25.title: every tasbih is charity
03-25.line: every 'SubhanAllah' is charity, every 'Allahu akbar' is charity.
03-25.meaning: even the poor can give, the Prophet ﷺ said: with words of praise.

03-26.title: mercy written
03-26.line: your Lord has written mercy upon himself.
03-26.meaning: mercy isn't an exception for Allah. it's a promise he made.

03-27.title: removing harm
03-27.line: removing something harmful from the road is charity.
03-27.meaning: pick up one thing in someone's way today.

03-28.title: zakat
03-28.meaning: giving a share of wealth each year cleans it and makes it grow.

03-29.title: not a leaf falls
03-29.line: not a leaf falls without his knowing it.
03-29.meaning: if every leaf is known, so is every worry you have.

03-30.title: Al-Fattah
03-30.meaning: he opens doors no one else can. ask him for an opening today.

03-31.title: all of me
03-31.line: my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah.
03-31.meaning: a whole life offered, not only the prayer times.

04-01.title: a good word is charity
04-01.meaning: from the same hadith: every joint in the body owes charity daily, and kind words pay it.

04-02.title: forgive and have mercy
04-02.line: my Lord, forgive and have mercy; you are the best of the merciful.
04-02.meaning: the last verse of Surah al-Mu'minun.

04-03.title: dhikr
04-03.meaning: a few words of remembrance on the bus or in the queue.

04-04.title: mercy is near
04-04.line: the mercy of Allah is near to those who do good.
04-04.meaning: doing good is a way of standing closer to mercy.

04-05.title: what righteousness is
04-05.meaning: and wrong is what bothers your heart and you'd hate others to see.

04-06.title: it embraces everything
04-06.meaning: there is nothing and no one outside of it.

04-07.title: tawakkul
04-07.line: tawakkul: trusting Allah, after doing your part.

04-08.title: Al-'Alim
04-08.meaning: he knows what you can't say out loud.

04-09.title: loved by people
04-09.line: do not covet what people have, and people will love you.

04-10.title: forgive and move on
04-10.line: hold to forgiveness, encourage what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
04-10.meaning: not every argument needs your answer.

04-11.title: in need
04-11.original: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
04-11.line: my Lord, i am truly in need of whatever good you send down to me.
04-11.meaning: Musa, tired and alone under a tree, prayed this. help came that same day.

04-12.title: morning and evening
04-12.line: remember your Lord within yourself, humbly, morning and evening.
04-12.meaning: a quiet remembrance at the edges of the day.

04-13.title: sabr
04-13.meaning: not passive waiting. holding firm with grace.

04-14.title: no harm
04-14.line: there should be no harming, nor returning harm.
04-14.meaning: the basis of many Islamic rulings: don't hurt, don't hurt back.

04-15.title: don't grieve
04-15.line: do not grieve; Allah is with us.
04-15.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ said this to Abu Bakr while hiding in a cave. a line for scary moments.

04-16.title: Al-Latif
04-16.meaning: his kindness often arrives quietly, through small things.

04-17.title: be brothers
04-17.line: do not envy one another, do not hate one another; be servants of Allah, as brothers.
04-17.meaning: a whole social life in one line.

04-18.title: shukr
04-18.meaning: shown in the heart, on the tongue, and in what you do.

04-19.title: he feels your pain
04-19.line: a messenger has come to you who is pained by your suffering.
04-19.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ is described as caring deeply, gentle and merciful.

04-20.title: no rancor
04-20.line: our Lord, leave no ill will in our hearts toward those who believe.
04-20.meaning: a du'a for a clean heart toward others.

04-21.title: no fear, no grief
04-21.line: the friends of Allah: no fear will be on them, nor will they grieve.
04-21.meaning: closeness to Allah is a kind of shelter.

04-22.title: relieve a hardship
04-22.line: whoever relieves a believer's hardship, Allah will relieve one of theirs.

04-23.title: ihsan
04-23.meaning: doing good as though Allah is watching, because he is.

04-24.title: every creature fed
04-24.line: there is no creature on earth whose provision is not with Allah.
04-24.meaning: from the bird to you. provision is cared for.

04-25.title: while you help
04-25.line: Allah helps his servant as long as the servant helps his brother.

04-26.title: Al-Halim
04-26.meaning: patient with us, not quick to punish.

04-27.title: my success
04-27.line: my success is only through Allah.
04-27.meaning: Prophet Shu'ayb's humble line. do your best, then give credit where it's due.

04-28.title: complete our light
04-28.line: our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us.
04-28.meaning: a prayer for the believers' light on the last day.

04-29.title: taqwa
04-29.meaning: a gentle awareness that guides choices.

04-30.title: good erases bad
04-30.line: good deeds wipe away bad ones.
04-30.meaning: a mistake can be followed by something good. start now.

05-01.title: the path to knowledge
05-01.line: whoever walks a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy a path to paradise.
05-01.meaning: every class, every book, every question counts.

05-02.title: nothing is wasted
05-02.line: be patient, for Allah does not let the reward of those who do good be lost.

05-03.title: niyyah
05-03.meaning: set it before you start, and ordinary work becomes worship.

05-04.title: a good intention
05-04.line: a good deed intended but not done is still written as a full good deed.

05-05.title: beautiful patience
05-05.meaning: Prophet Ya'qub's answer to heartbreak: sabrun jamil, patience without complaint to people.

05-06.title: keep me praying
05-06.line: my Lord, make me and my children steadfast in prayer.

05-07.title: Al-Ghafur
05-07.meaning: he covers our faults and forgives.

05-08.title: only to allah
05-08.line: i complain of my sorrow and grief only to Allah.
05-08.meaning: Ya'qub poured his grief out to Allah. you can too.

05-09.title: drawing near
05-09.line: my servant keeps drawing near to me with extra good deeds until i love him.
05-09.meaning: small, voluntary acts of worship build closeness.

05-10.title: ummah
05-10.meaning: people all over the world, praying toward the same point.

05-11.title: never despair
05-11.line: do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
05-11.meaning: Ya'qub told his sons to keep searching for Yusuf. hope keeps looking.

05-12.title: mistakes forgiven
05-12.line: Allah has pardoned my community for mistakes, forgetting, and what they are forced into.
05-12.meaning: you're not held to what you couldn't help.

05-13.title: no blame today
05-13.line: there is no blame on you today.
05-13.meaning: Yusuf forgives the brothers who wronged him. the Prophet ﷺ is reported to have said the same at the conquest of Makkah.

05-14.title: for all the believers
05-14.line: our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers.

05-15.title: the qiblah
05-15.line: five times a day, Muslims everywhere face the Ka'bah.
05-15.meaning: a circle of prayer that wraps the whole earth.

05-16.title: Ash-Shakur
05-16.meaning: Allah notices and rewards even the smallest good. he's grateful too.

05-17.title: the most high
05-17.line: glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High.
05-17.meaning: in every prostration, Muslims say 'glory be to my Lord, the Most High.'

05-18.title: change begins within
05-18.line: Allah does not change a people's condition until they change what is in themselves.

05-19.title: a traveler
05-19.line: be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.

05-20.title: jumu'ah
05-20.line: the best day the sun rises on is Friday.
05-20.meaning: the day of the weekly congregational prayer.

05-21.title: hearts at rest
05-21.line: in the remembrance of Allah, hearts find rest.
05-21.meaning: when your mind is racing, a little dhikr can be a resting place.

05-22.title: clouds of sins
05-22.line: as long as you call on me and hope in me, i will forgive you.
05-22.meaning: Allah speaks to the son of Adam: even if your sins reached the clouds. the door is never shut.

05-23.title: more for the grateful
05-23.line: if you are grateful, i will give you more.

05-24.title: a truthful entrance
05-24.line: my Lord, let me enter with truth and leave with truth.
05-24.meaning: good for new jobs, new homes, new chapters.

05-25.title: Al-Hafiz
05-25.meaning: he guards what matters. rest in that.

05-26.title: salawat
05-26.line: send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ.
05-26.meaning: whoever sends one blessing on him, Allah sends ten upon them.

05-27.title: a good word is a tree
05-27.line: a good word is like a good tree: firm roots, branches in the sky.
05-27.meaning: kind words keep giving fruit long after you've said them.

05-28.title: the strong one
05-28.line: the strong one is not the wrestler, but the one who controls himself when angry.

05-29.title: countless blessings
05-29.line: if you tried to count Allah's blessings, you could not number them.
05-29.meaning: try counting a few anyway. it changes the day.

05-30.title: smile
05-30.line: your smile in your brother's face is charity.

05-31.title: the greatest verse
05-31.line: Ayat al-Kursi is the greatest verse of the Qur'an.
05-31.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ told Ubayy ibn Ka'b so. many recite it before sleep.

06-01.title: when the heart is tight
06-01.line: glorify your Lord and be among those who bow down.
06-01.meaning: told to the Prophet ﷺ when his chest felt tight from what people said. prayer as comfort.

06-02.title: enough is allah
06-02.original: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
06-02.line: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but him; in him i trust.
06-02.meaning: a du'a many say in the morning and evening. it closes Surah at-Tawbah.

06-03.title: Al-Karim
06-03.meaning: giving more than deserved, and giving with dignity.

06-04.title: gentleness
06-04.line: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
06-04.meaning: gentle tone, gentle hands, gentle words.

06-05.title: justice and excellence
06-05.line: Allah commands justice, excellence, and giving to relatives.
06-05.meaning: read in many Friday sermons. three good habits in one line.

06-06.title: a third of the qur'an
06-06.line: Surah al-Ikhlas equals a third of the Qur'an.
06-06.meaning: four short lines, a whole world of meaning.

06-07.title: a good life
06-07.line: whoever does good, man or woman, with faith, we will give them a good life.
06-07.meaning: goodness has its own reward, here and later.

06-08.title: best to family
06-08.line: the best of you are those who are best to their families.

06-09.title: invite with wisdom
06-09.line: invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and kind teaching.
06-09.meaning: faith is shared gently, never forced.

06-10.title: when worried
06-10.line: o Allah, i seek refuge in you from worry and grief.
06-10.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ often sought refuge with these words. you can hand worry over too.

06-11.title: the right side
06-11.line: the Prophet ﷺ loved to start with the right.
06-11.meaning: putting on shoes, entering the masjid, combing hair.

06-12.title: small and steady
06-12.line: the most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
06-12.meaning: a little every day beats a lot once in a while.

06-13.title: don't say 'uff'
06-13.line: do not even say 'uff' to your parents.
06-13.meaning: not even a sigh of annoyance. a high bar for kindness at home.

06-15.title: lower the wing
06-15.line: lower to them the wing of humility, out of mercy.
06-15.meaning: a tender picture of caring for aging parents, like a bird covering its young.

06-16.title: food for two
06-16.line: food for two is enough for three.

06-17.title: make it easy
06-17.line: make things easy, not hard; give good news, don't drive people away.
06-17.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's advice to those he sent to teach.

06-18.title: walk gently
06-18.line: do not walk on the earth with arrogance.
06-18.meaning: humble steps, today and every day.

06-19.title: in distress
06-19.line: there is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing.
06-19.meaning: a du'a the Prophet ﷺ said at times of distress.

06-20.title: the merciful
06-20.line: the merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. be merciful on earth.

06-21.title: no complaining about food
06-21.line: the Prophet ﷺ never criticized food.
06-21.meaning: if he liked it, he ate; if not, he left it quietly.

06-22.title: everything praises
06-22.line: everything glorifies him, but you do not understand their praise.
06-22.meaning: trees, stones, birds: all of it praising in its own way.

06-23.title: Al-Wadud
06-23.meaning: Allah's love is warm and real, and he loves those who turn to him.

06-24.title: say what's best
06-24.line: tell my servants to say what is best.
06-24.meaning: not just what's true. what's best.

06-25.title: hearts and deeds
06-25.line: Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but at your hearts and deeds.

06-26.title: at home
06-26.line: the Prophet ﷺ helped his family at home.
06-26.meaning: Aisha said he served his household, then went out to pray.

06-27.title: honored
06-27.line: we have honored the children of Adam.
06-27.meaning: every human being carries dignity, given by Allah.

06-28.title: wellbeing
06-28.line: o Allah, i ask you for well-being in this world and the next.
06-28.meaning: 'afiyah covers it all: safety, peace, ease.

06-29.title: religion is ease
06-29.meaning: whoever overburdens themselves in it will be overwhelmed. go steady.

06-30.title: insha'Allah
06-30.line: never say of anything, 'i will do it tomorrow,' without 'if Allah wills.'
06-30.meaning: the root of insha'Allah: plan, and hold it humbly.

07-01.title: his character
07-01.meaning: Aisha's description of the Prophet ﷺ.

07-02.title: Al-Hakim
07-02.meaning: there's wisdom even in what we don't understand yet.

07-03.title: the sea as ink
07-03.line: if the sea were ink for the words of my Lord, it would run out first.

07-04.title: your mother
07-04.line: your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father.
07-04.meaning: asked who most deserves good company, the Prophet ﷺ named mothers three times.

07-05.title: never let down
07-05.line: i have never been disappointed in my prayer to you, my Lord.
07-05.meaning: Prophet Zakariya's line, said in old age. a lifetime of prayers heard.

07-06.title: a steady heart
07-06.original: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
07-06.line: o turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on your religion.
07-06.meaning: the du'a the Prophet ﷺ said most often, according to Umm Salamah.

07-07.title: always smiling
07-07.line: i never saw anyone smile more than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.
07-07.meaning: Abdullah ibn al-Harith's memory of him.

07-08.title: two light words
07-08.original: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
07-08.line: two phrases, light on the tongue and heavy on the scale.
07-08.meaning: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-Azim. this is the very last hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari.

07-09.title: shake the palm
07-09.line: shake the trunk of the palm toward you; fresh dates will fall.
07-09.meaning: Maryam, alone and in labor, is told to reach out. help comes when we move toward it.

07-11.title: i hear and see
07-11.line: do not fear; i am with you both, hearing and seeing.
07-11.meaning: Allah to Musa and Harun before facing Pharaoh.

07-12.title: care for animals
07-12.line: there is reward in caring for every living creature.
07-12.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ said so after the story of the thirsty dog.

07-13.title: a hundred parts
07-13.line: Allah divided mercy into a hundred parts and sent one down to earth.
07-13.meaning: all the mercy in the world, including a mother's for her child, is one part. ninety-nine are kept.

07-14.title: speak gently
07-14.line: speak to him gently, so perhaps he may remember.
07-14.meaning: Musa was told to be gentle even with Pharaoh. gentleness first.

07-15.title: help me remember
07-15.line: o Allah, help me to remember you, thank you, and worship you well.
07-15.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ told Mu'adh he loved him, then taught him this.

07-16.title: the lost camel
07-16.line: Allah is more pleased with a servant's repentance than a traveler who finds his lost camel.
07-16.meaning: turning back to Allah brings him joy.

07-17.title: water, a charity
07-17.line: the best charity is giving water.
07-17.meaning: Sa'd ibn Ubadah dug a well in his mother's name.

07-18.title: from water
07-18.line: we made every living thing from water.
07-18.meaning: drink a glass of water slowly today. it's a sign too.

07-19.title: Al-Wakil
07-19.meaning: the one you can hand your affairs to.

07-20.title: mercy to the worlds
07-20.line: we sent you only as a mercy to all the worlds.
07-20.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ was sent as mercy. that's the measure.

07-21.title: tie your camel
07-21.line: tie your camel, and trust in Allah.
07-21.meaning: do your part, then let go.

07-22.title: seek knowledge
07-22.line: seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim.

07-23.title: humble in prayer
07-23.line: successful are the believers who are humble in their prayers.
07-23.meaning: the quality of the prayer, not the speed.

07-24.title: peace from you
07-24.line: o Allah, you are Peace, and from you is peace. blessed are you.
07-24.meaning: said right after finishing each prayer.

07-25.title: like the birds
07-25.line: if you trusted Allah truly, you'd be provided for like the birds: out hungry, home full.
07-25.meaning: birds still fly out each morning. trust includes going.

07-26.title: pardon and overlook
07-26.line: let them pardon and overlook. don't you love that Allah forgives you?
07-26.meaning: revealed when Abu Bakr was hurt by someone he supported. he kept supporting him.

07-27.title: angels' wings
07-27.line: the angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge.

07-28.title: light upon light
07-28.line: Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth.
07-28.meaning: the famous light verse: a lamp in a niche, glowing. light upon light.

07-29.title: the upper hand
07-29.line: the upper hand is better than the lower hand.
07-29.meaning: the giving hand is the upper one.

07-31.title: walk humbly, say peace
07-31.line: the servants of the Most Merciful walk gently, and answer the ignorant with 'peace.'
07-31.meaning: when someone is rude, 'peace' is an answer too.

08-01.title: for the road
08-01.line: glory to him who has placed this in our service.
08-01.meaning: said when setting out on a journey.

08-02.title: surah al-kahf
08-02.line: many read Surah al-Kahf on Friday.
08-02.meaning: a weekly story of the cave, the garden, Musa and Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn.

08-03.title: charity doesn't shrink
08-03.meaning: giving doesn't make you poorer in what counts.

08-04.title: grateful like sulayman
08-04.line: my Lord, inspire me to be grateful for your favor upon me and my parents.
08-04.meaning: Sulayman smiled at the ant's words and prayed this.

08-05.title: the thirsty dog
08-05.line: a man gave water to a thirsty dog, and Allah forgave him.
08-05.meaning: mercy to animals counts with Allah.

08-06.title: the ant
08-06.line: enter your homes, lest Sulayman and his army crush you without knowing.
08-06.meaning: an ant warns her colony. even small voices matter.

08-07.title: between adhan and iqamah
08-07.line: a du'a between the call to prayer and its start is not turned away.

08-08.title: Al-Qayyum
08-08.meaning: he holds everything up, every moment.

08-09.title: do good as good was done
08-09.line: do good, as Allah has done good to you.

08-10.title: doors of mercy
08-10.line: o Allah, open for me the doors of your mercy.

08-11.title: one body
08-11.line: the believers are like one body: when one part aches, the whole body feels it.
08-11.meaning: someone else's pain is ours too.

08-12.title: prayer protects
08-12.line: prayer keeps one away from indecency and wrong, and remembrance of Allah is greater.
08-12.meaning: prayer shapes the rest of the day.

08-13.title: the tasbih
08-13.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ taught this to Fatimah instead of a servant, as a source of strength.

08-14.title: safe from you
08-14.line: a Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand people are safe.

08-15.title: we will guide them
08-15.line: those who strive for us, we will surely guide them to our ways.
08-15.meaning: the effort is met with guidance.

08-16.title: weakness upon weakness
08-16.line: his mother carried him in weakness upon weakness.
08-16.meaning: a verse that honors what mothers give. thank yours, or remember her today.

08-17.title: An-Nur
08-17.meaning: the light that lets everything else be seen.

08-18.title: khadijah
08-18.line: Khadijah was the first to believe.
08-18.meaning: when the first revelation shook him, she wrapped the Prophet ﷺ in comfort and said Allah would never disgrace him.

08-19.title: love and mercy
08-19.line: he placed between you affection and mercy.
08-19.meaning: a verse often read at weddings. love grows with mercy.

08-20.title: useful knowledge
08-20.line: o Allah, i seek refuge in you from knowledge that does not benefit.

08-21.title: no small good
08-21.line: do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
08-21.meaning: a smile is a real good deed.

08-22.title: many tongues and colors
08-22.line: among his signs are the variety of your languages and colors.
08-22.meaning: human diversity is a sign of Allah, meant to be noticed.

08-23.title: abu bakr
08-23.meaning: called as-Siddiq, the truthful, the Prophet ﷺ's closest friend.

08-24.title: spread peace
08-24.line: spread salam, feed people, and pray at night while others sleep.
08-24.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's first teaching in Madinah, as reported by Abdullah ibn Salam.

08-25.title: be grateful
08-25.line: be grateful to Allah; whoever is grateful is grateful for their own good.
08-25.meaning: Luqman's first advice to his son: gratitude.

08-26.title: Al-Hadi
08-26.meaning: he guides hearts, step by step.

08-27.title: luqman's advice
08-27.line: be patient with whatever befalls you.
08-27.meaning: Luqman tells his son: pray, do good, and be patient.

08-28.title: beautify my character
08-28.line: o Allah, you made my form beautiful, so make my character beautiful.

08-29.title: beautiful
08-29.line: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
08-29.meaning: dressing nicely and making things lovely can be part of faith.

08-30.title: umar's justice
08-30.line: Umar ibn al-Khattab was known for justice.
08-30.meaning: the second caliph walked the streets at night to check on the hungry.

08-31.title: lower your voice
08-31.line: be moderate in your pace and lower your voice.
08-31.meaning: Luqman's gentle advice about walking and talking.

09-01.title: thank people
09-01.line: whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

09-02.title: remember often
09-02.line: remember Allah often, and glorify him morning and evening.
09-02.meaning: a little at the start and end of every day.

09-03.title: uthman's generosity
09-03.line: Uthman bought a well and gave its water freely.
09-03.meaning: the well of Rumah, in Madinah, open to everyone.

09-04.title: peace, a word
09-04.line: 'peace': a word from a merciful Lord.
09-04.meaning: the greeting of paradise is simply peace.

09-05.title: light in my heart
09-05.line: o Allah, place light in my heart.
09-05.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ asked for light everywhere: heart, sight, hearing, right, left, above, below.

09-06.title: Al-'Afuw
09-06.meaning: not just forgiving, but erasing as if it never happened.

09-07.title: before the sweat dries
09-07.line: give the worker his wage before his sweat dries.

09-08.title: be, and it is
09-08.line: when he wills a thing, he says to it 'be,' and it is.
09-08.meaning: nothing is too hard for Allah.

09-09.title: ali's wisdom
09-09.line: Ali ibn Abi Talib was raised in the Prophet ﷺ's house.
09-09.meaning: known for courage, knowledge, and deep wisdom.

09-10.title: heaviest on the scale
09-10.line: nothing is heavier on the scale than good character.

09-11.title: all sins
09-11.line: do not despair of Allah's mercy; Allah forgives all sins.
09-11.meaning: said to those who have wronged themselves. the door stays open.

09-12.title: call on me
09-12.line: call on me, i will answer you.

09-13.title: leaving home
09-13.line: in the name of Allah; i trust in Allah; there is no power except with Allah.

09-14.title: fatimah
09-14.line: Fatimah was dear to the Prophet ﷺ.
09-14.meaning: he would stand to greet her when she entered.

09-15.title: visit the sick
09-15.line: feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive.
09-15.meaning: three direct instructions. pick one this week.

09-17.title: repel with better
09-17.line: repel harm with what is better, and an enemy may become a close friend.
09-17.meaning: answer meanness with kindness. it can change everything.

09-18.title: i was sick
09-18.line: i was sick and you did not visit me.
09-18.meaning: Allah asks: did you not know that had you visited him, you would have found me there?

09-19.title: aisha the teacher
09-19.line: Aisha taught the companions for decades.
09-19.meaning: many hadith come from her memory and learning.

09-20.title: patience and forgiveness
09-20.line: whoever is patient and forgives, that is a matter of great resolve.

09-21.title: tranquility sent down
09-21.line: he sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers.
09-21.meaning: sakina: a calm that is given. ask for it today.

09-22.title: before sleep
09-22.line: in your name, o Allah, i die and i live.
09-22.meaning: said at bedtime. sleep as a small rest in his care.

09-23.title: running toward you
09-23.line: if my servant comes to me walking, i come to him running.
09-23.meaning: one small step toward Allah is met with more.

09-24.title: At-Tawwab
09-24.meaning: he turns toward us every time we turn back.

09-25.title: bilal's word
09-25.meaning: Bilal repeated this while tortured for his faith. later, he became the first muezzin.

09-26.title: make peace
09-26.line: the believers are brothers, so make peace between them.
09-26.meaning: be the one who helps two people reconcile.

09-27.title: as you think of me
09-27.line: i am as my servant thinks of me.
09-27.meaning: think well of Allah. expect mercy.

09-28.title: no mocking
09-28.line: let no people mock another people; perhaps they are better than them.
09-28.meaning: no nicknames that hurt, no put-downs.

09-29.title: salman's search
09-29.line: Salman al-Farisi traveled from Persia searching for truth.
09-29.meaning: his long search led him to Madinah, where he became a beloved companion of the Prophet ﷺ.

09-30.title: avoid suspicion
09-30.line: avoid much suspicion, do not spy, and do not backbite.
09-30.meaning: assume the best of people today.

10-01.title: the believer's wonder
10-01.line: how wonderful is the believer's affair: all of it is good.
10-01.meaning: in ease they're grateful; in hardship they're patient. both are good.

10-02.title: on waking
10-02.line: praise be to Allah who gave us life after he had made us sleep.
10-02.meaning: the first words of the day.

10-03.title: As-Sami'
10-03.meaning: even the whisper you didn't say out loud.

10-04.title: to know one another
10-04.line: we made you nations and tribes so that you may know one another.
10-04.meaning: differences are for getting to know each other.

10-05.title: the hijrah
10-05.line: the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr left Makkah for Madinah.
10-05.meaning: the Islamic calendar counts from this journey.

10-06.title: even a thorn
10-06.line: no worry, sadness, or even a thorn's prick touches a believer but Allah erases sins with it.

10-07.title: closer than your vein
10-07.line: we are closer to him than his jugular vein.
10-07.meaning: Allah is nearer than your own heartbeat.

10-08.title: tell them
10-08.line: if you love your brother, tell him.

10-09.title: what you strive for
10-09.line: a person has only what they strive for.

10-10.title: when it rains
10-10.line: o Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
10-10.meaning: rain is a mercy. there's a du'a for it.

10-11.title: the ansar
10-11.line: the people of Madinah shared their homes with those who arrived.
10-11.meaning: they gave even when they were in need themselves.

10-12.title: which favors?
10-12.line: so which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
10-12.meaning: Surah ar-Rahman repeats this 31 times. look around: so many gifts.

10-13.title: Al-Basir
10-13.meaning: nothing you do in kindness goes unseen.

10-14.title: plant a tree
10-14.line: whatever a bird or person eats from a tree you planted is charity for you.

10-15.title: good for good
10-15.line: is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

10-16.title: the people of ta'if
10-16.line: the Prophet ﷺ was hurt at Ta'if, and still prayed for them.
10-16.meaning: he hoped their children would worship Allah. they did.

10-17.title: the sapling
10-17.line: if the Hour comes and you hold a sapling, plant it.
10-17.meaning: keep doing good, right to the end.

10-18.title: wherever you are
10-18.line: he is with you wherever you are.
10-18.meaning: on the bus, in the kitchen, at your desk.

10-19.title: istikhara
10-19.line: o Allah, i ask you to guide me by your knowledge.
10-19.meaning: the prayer for choosing well. the Prophet ﷺ taught it like a surah of the Qur'an.

10-20.title: ibrahim's guests
10-20.line: Ibrahim hurried to serve his guests a roasted calf.
10-20.meaning: hospitality is the way of the prophets.

10-21.title: hold lightly
10-21.line: do not grieve over what you missed, nor be boastful over what you were given.
10-21.meaning: a steady heart, in loss and in gain.

10-22.title: Al-Jabbar
10-22.meaning: the root also means setting a broken bone. he mends broken hearts.

10-23.title: learn and teach
10-23.line: the best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

10-24.title: after friday prayer
10-24.line: when the prayer is finished, spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty.

10-25.title: nuh's ark
10-25.line: Nuh built the ark for years while people laughed.
10-25.meaning: keep doing what's right, even if no one understands.

10-26.title: double reward
10-26.line: one who reads the Qur'an with difficulty gets a double reward.
10-26.meaning: struggling with Arabic? that effort is doubly rewarded.

10-27.title: as much as you can
10-27.line: be mindful of Allah as much as you are able.
10-27.meaning: your best is what's asked. not more.

10-28.title: after wudu
10-28.line: i bear witness that there is no god but Allah.
10-28.meaning: said after wudu; the Prophet ﷺ said the gates of paradise open for it.

10-29.title: a way out
10-29.line: whoever is mindful of Allah, he will make a way out for them.
10-29.meaning: and provide from where they never expected.

10-30.title: closest in sujud
10-30.line: a servant is closest to their Lord while in prostration.
10-30.meaning: the lowest posture is the nearest.

10-31.title: ayyub's patience
10-31.line: my Lord, hardship has touched me, and you are the most merciful.
10-31.meaning: Ayyub's du'a after years of loss. he was healed and restored.

11-02.title: he is enough
11-02.line: whoever relies on Allah, he is enough for them.
11-02.meaning: you don't have to have it all handled.

11-03.title: the last third
11-03.line: Allah descends in the last third of the night: who is calling, that i may answer?
11-03.meaning: a quiet hour before dawn is an open door.

11-04.title: the test
11-04.line: he created death and life to test which of you is best in deeds.
11-04.meaning: not the most deeds. the best.

11-05.title: the master of forgiveness
11-05.line: o Allah, you are my Lord; you created me, and i am your servant.
11-05.meaning: Sayyid al-Istighfar, the best way to ask forgiveness, said morning and evening.

11-06.title: yusuf in prison
11-06.line: even in prison, Yusuf was kind and helped others.
11-06.meaning: his cellmates said: we see you are one who does good.

11-07.title: look again
11-07.line: look at the sky again: do you see any flaw?
11-07.meaning: a verse that invites you to look up and wonder.

11-08.title: du'a is worship
11-08.meaning: asking is itself an act of love.

11-09.title: Al-Wali
11-09.meaning: Allah as a friend who looks out for you.

11-10.title: great character
11-10.line: you are truly of an excellent character.
11-10.meaning: Allah's own praise of the Prophet ﷺ. character is the highest compliment.

11-11.title: musa's mother
11-11.line: put him in the river, and do not fear.
11-11.meaning: Allah promised Musa's mother he'd return to her. he did.

11-12.title: for the absent
11-12.line: when you pray for an absent brother, an angel says: 'and for you the same.'
11-12.meaning: pray for someone today. it comes back.

11-13.title: devote yourself
11-13.line: remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to him completely.
11-13.meaning: a few minutes of full attention count.

11-14.title: sneezing
11-14.line: alhamdulillah. and the reply: may Allah have mercy on you.
11-14.meaning: even a sneeze becomes a moment of thanks and blessing.

11-15.title: check the news
11-15.line: if news comes to you from someone unreliable, verify it first.
11-15.meaning: before you share or react, check. it saves a lot of harm.

11-16.title: dawud's song
11-16.line: the mountains and birds sang praise with Dawud.

11-17.title: for his sake
11-17.line: we feed you only for the sake of Allah; we want no reward or thanks.

11-18.title: the neighbor
11-18.line: Jibril kept advising me about the neighbor until i thought he'd make him an heir.

11-20.title: soul at peace
11-20.line: o soul at peace, return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing.
11-20.meaning: a verse of homecoming. may your heart be at peace today.

11-21.title: keep family ties
11-21.line: whoever wants their provision widened, let them keep ties with family.
11-21.meaning: call a relative you haven't spoken to in a while.

11-22.title: maryam's honor
11-22.line: Maryam was chosen above the women of the worlds.
11-22.meaning: a whole surah carries her name.

11-23.title: not forsaken
11-23.line: your Lord has not left you, nor is he displeased.
11-23.meaning: revealed when the Prophet ﷺ felt alone. a surah for low days.

11-24.title: before eating
11-24.meaning: say Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what's in front of you.

11-25.title: better is coming
11-25.line: what comes after will be better for you than what came before.
11-25.meaning: from Surah ad-Duha. the morning after the night.

11-26.title: give gifts
11-26.line: give gifts to one another, and you will love one another.

11-27.title: isa's kindness
11-27.line: Isa, son of Maryam, was sent with clear signs.
11-27.meaning: Muslims honor him as a great prophet of mercy.

11-28.title: speak of blessings
11-28.line: as for your Lord's blessing, speak of it.
11-28.meaning: share one good thing that happened today.

11-29.title: Al-Ahad
11-29.meaning: one, with no partner and no equal.

11-30.title: like rain
11-30.line: the guidance i was sent with is like rain falling on land.
11-30.meaning: some soil drinks it, some holds it for others. be good ground.

12-01.title: with hardship, ease
12-01.meaning: said twice in a row, so you don't miss it.

12-02.title: accept from us
12-02.line: our Lord, accept from us; you are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
12-02.meaning: Ibrahim and Isma'il's prayer as they raised the Ka'bah's walls.

12-03.title: the people of the cave
12-03.line: they were youths who believed, and we increased them in guidance.

12-04.title: the weeping tree trunk
12-04.line: the date-palm trunk wept when the Prophet ﷺ moved to a new pulpit.
12-04.meaning: he came down and comforted it until it quieted. even a tree missed him.

12-05.title: read
12-05.line: read, in the name of your Lord who created.
12-05.meaning: the first word revealed was iqra: read. learning is worship.

12-06.title: an atom of good
12-06.line: whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.
12-06.meaning: nothing good is too small to count.

12-07.title: good company
12-07.line: a good friend is like a perfume seller.
12-07.meaning: even if you buy nothing, you leave smelling sweet.

12-08.title: As-Samad
12-08.meaning: everyone needs him; he needs no one.

12-09.title: with excellence
12-09.line: Allah loves that when one of you does a job, you do it well.
12-09.meaning: itqan: doing it right. the small jobs too.

12-10.title: by time
12-10.line: by time, people are in loss, except those who believe and do good...
12-10.meaning: ...and urge one another to truth and to patience. the whole of a good life in three short lines.

12-11.title: patience poured out
12-11.line: our Lord, pour patience upon us.
12-11.meaning: the prayer of believers facing a hard day.

12-12.title: young and old
12-12.line: whoever does not show mercy to our young and respect our elders is not of us.
12-12.meaning: gentle with kids, respectful with elders.

12-13.title: small kindnesses
12-13.meaning: Surah al-Ma'un warns against holding back little helps. lend the cup of sugar.

12-14.title: visiting the sick
12-14.line: whoever visits the sick walks in the garden of paradise until they return.
12-14.meaning: a visit is a walk through paradise.

12-15.title: he is one
12-15.line: say: he is Allah, the One.
12-15.meaning: Surah al-Ikhlas. the Prophet ﷺ said it equals a third of the Qur'an.

12-16.title: the orphan's guardian
12-16.line: i and the one who cares for an orphan will be in paradise like this.
12-16.meaning: and he held up two fingers, close together.

12-17.title: Al-Muhaymin
12-17.meaning: always watching over, always caring for.

12-18.title: gentle with women
12-18.line: be gentle with the glass vessels.
12-18.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's tender words about the women traveling on camelback.

12-19.title: the lord of dawn
12-19.line: say: i seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.
12-19.meaning: Surah al-Falaq, recited for protection morning and evening.

12-20.title: seeking refuge
12-20.line: i seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what he created.

12-21.title: the strong believer
12-21.line: strive for what benefits you, seek Allah's help, and do not give up.
12-21.meaning: and don't say 'if only.' say: Allah decreed, and did what he willed.

12-22.title: the lord of people
12-22.line: say: i seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
12-22.meaning: the last surah of the Qur'an, a shelter from whispering worries.

12-23.title: the white days
12-23.line: many fast the 13th, 14th and 15th of each Islamic month.
12-23.meaning: the white days, when the moon is full and bright.

12-24.title: speak kindly
12-24.line: speak to people in a good way.
12-24.meaning: part of the covenant with the Children of Israel, and a rule for every day.

12-25.title: modesty brings good
12-25.meaning: haya: a gentle sense of what's fitting.

12-26.title: ninety-nine names
12-26.line: Allah has ninety-nine names; whoever learns them by heart enters paradise.
12-26.meaning: learning his names is a way of knowing him.

12-27.title: the gift of wisdom
12-27.line: whoever is given wisdom has been given much good.
12-27.meaning: wisdom is a treasure. ask for it.

12-28.title: guidance and purity
12-28.original: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
12-28.line: o Allah, i ask you for guidance, piety, purity, and contentment.
12-28.meaning: four gifts in one short du'a.

12-29.title: monday and thursday
12-29.line: the Prophet ﷺ liked to fast on Mondays and Thursdays.
12-29.meaning: deeds are presented on those days, he said.

12-30.title: not until you love
12-30.line: you will not believe until you love one another. spread salam among you.

12-31.title: give time
12-31.line: if someone owes you and is struggling, give them time.
12-31.meaning: and forgiving the debt is even better, the verse adds.

2026-11-11.title: Jumada al-Akhirah begins
2026-11-11.line: a new Islamic month begins with the crescent.
2026-11-11.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ would say on seeing a new moon: may it bring blessing, faith, safety and peace. (date may vary by a day)

2026-12-10.title: Rajab begins
2026-12-10.line: Rajab is one of the four sacred months.
2026-12-10.meaning: a quieter month to make peace and prepare the heart. Ramadan is two months away. (date may vary by a day)

2027-01-04.title: the night journey
2027-01-04.line: glory be to him who took his servant by night.
2027-01-04.meaning: tonight, where observed, Muslims remember the Prophet ﷺ's night journey and ascent, when the five prayers were given. (date may vary by a day)

2027-01-09.title: Sha'ban begins
2027-01-09.line: Sha'ban is the month before Ramadan.
2027-01-09.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ fasted more in Sha'ban than any month besides Ramadan. a good time to warm up. (date may vary by a day)

2027-01-22.title: the night of 15 sha'ban
2027-01-22.line: a night many spend in prayer and asking forgiveness.
2027-01-22.meaning: tonight, where observed, is Laylat al-Bara'ah. a gentle time to forgive others before Ramadan. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-07.title: watching for the moon
2027-02-07.line: the month of mercy begins with a new moon.
2027-02-07.meaning: tonight the crescent is sought. the first taraweeh prayers may be tonight, and the first fast tomorrow. ramadan mubarak. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-08.title: fasting prescribed
2027-02-08.line: fasting is prescribed for you, as it was for those before you, so you may be mindful.
2027-02-08.meaning: the first fast. the goal is taqwa: a heart awake to Allah. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-09.title: the month of the qur'an
2027-02-09.line: the month of Ramadan, in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance.
2027-02-09.meaning: a good month to read a little each day, even one page. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-10.title: the blessed meal
2027-02-10.line: eat suhoor, for there is blessing in it.
2027-02-10.meaning: even a sip of water and a date before dawn counts. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-11.title: a shield
2027-02-11.meaning: it guards the tongue and the temper, not just the stomach. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-12.title: like the wind
2027-02-12.line: the Prophet ﷺ was most generous in Ramadan, faster than the blowing wind.
2027-02-12.meaning: give something today, quickly and gladly. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-13.title: two joys
2027-02-13.line: the fasting person has two joys: when they break their fast, and when they meet their Lord.
2027-02-13.meaning: enjoy tonight's iftar fully. that joy is part of the worship. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-14.title: dates and water
2027-02-14.line: break your fast with dates; if you have none, with water.
2027-02-14.meaning: the simplest start to iftar, following the Prophet ﷺ. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-15.title: feed a fasting person
2027-02-15.line: whoever gives iftar to a fasting person gets the same reward.
2027-02-15.meaning: share your table, or send a meal. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-16.title: for me
2027-02-16.line: fasting is for me, and i will reward it.
2027-02-16.meaning: a hadith qudsi: fasting is a private gift between you and Allah. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-17.title: faith and hope
2027-02-17.line: whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hoping for reward, their past sins are forgiven.
2027-02-17.meaning: the intention makes the hunger meaningful. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-18.title: i am fasting
2027-02-18.line: if someone insults you, say: 'i am fasting.'
2027-02-18.meaning: a fast includes the temper. let it pass. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-19.title: more than food
2027-02-19.line: whoever doesn't give up false speech, Allah has no need of them giving up food.
2027-02-19.meaning: the fast of the tongue matters most. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-20.title: open gates
2027-02-20.line: when Ramadan comes, the gates of paradise are opened.
2027-02-20.meaning: it's a month when good feels easier. lean into it. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-21.title: standing at night
2027-02-21.line: whoever prays at night in Ramadan with faith and hope, their past sins are forgiven.
2027-02-21.meaning: taraweeh, even a few rak'ahs at home. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-22.title: ar-rayyan
2027-02-22.line: in paradise there is a gate called ar-Rayyan, only for those who fast.
2027-02-22.meaning: a special welcome for the thirsty. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-23.title: i am near
2027-02-23.line: i answer the call of the one who calls, when they call on me.
2027-02-23.meaning: this promise sits right in the middle of the verses on fasting. before iftar, take a quiet minute to ask. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-24.title: reading together
2027-02-24.line: Jibril would review the Qur'an with the Prophet ﷺ every Ramadan.
2027-02-24.meaning: read with someone today, out loud. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-25.title: thirst is gone
2027-02-25.line: the thirst is gone, the veins are moist, and the reward is sure, if Allah wills.
2027-02-25.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ's words at iftar. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-26.title: feeling hunger
2027-02-26.line: a day of hunger can open the heart to the hungry.
2027-02-26.meaning: think of someone who goes without, and help if you can. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-27.title: tonight: the 21st night
2027-02-27.line: the Prophet ﷺ would stay up at night and wake his family in the last ten.
2027-02-27.meaning: Aisha described how he gave these nights everything. the search for Laylat al-Qadr begins tonight. (date may vary by a day)

2027-02-28.title: i'tikaf
2027-02-28.line: the Prophet ﷺ spent the last ten days of Ramadan in the masjid.
2027-02-28.meaning: i'tikaf: stepping back from the world to be near Allah. even an hour counts. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-01.title: tonight: the 23rd night
2027-03-01.line: seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten.
2027-03-01.meaning: tonight is one of them. even a few minutes of prayer or a kind act counts. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-02.title: better than a thousand months
2027-03-02.line: Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
2027-03-02.meaning: one night worth more than a lifetime. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-03.title: tonight: the 25th night
2027-03-03.original: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
2027-03-03.line: o Allah, you are pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me.
2027-03-03.meaning: the du'a the Prophet ﷺ taught Aisha for Laylat al-Qadr. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-04.title: the angels descend
2027-03-04.line: the angels and the Spirit descend on that night.
2027-03-04.meaning: the night when heaven feels close. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-05.title: tonight: the 27th night
2027-03-05.line: whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr with faith and hope, their past sins are forgiven.
2027-03-05.meaning: many hope tonight is the night. whatever night it is, it's worth showing up. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-06.title: peace until dawn
2027-03-06.line: it is peace until the rising of the dawn.
2027-03-06.meaning: the last line of Surah al-Qadr. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-07.title: tonight: the 29th night
2027-03-07.line: give zakat al-fitr before the Eid prayer.
2027-03-07.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ made this small gift of food obligatory so everyone can celebrate Eid. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-08.title: watching for the moon
2027-03-08.line: tonight the new moon of Shawwal is sought.
2027-03-08.meaning: if it's seen, Eid is tomorrow; if not, there's one more fast. the takbir begins when Eid is announced. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-09.title: eid mubarak
2027-03-09.line: may Allah accept from us and from you.
2027-03-09.meaning: the greeting the companions shared on Eid. pray, eat, visit, give, and enjoy. (date may vary by a day)

2027-03-10.title: six more days
2027-03-10.line: fasting Ramadan and then six days of Shawwal is like fasting a whole year.
2027-03-10.meaning: no rush: any six days this month count. (date may vary by a day)

2027-04-08.title: Dhul Qa'dah begins
2027-04-08.line: Dhul Qa'dah is a sacred month.
2027-04-08.meaning: pilgrims begin preparing for Hajj. a month of rest from conflict. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-07.title: the best ten days
2027-05-07.line: there are no days when good deeds are more beloved to Allah than these ten.
2027-05-07.meaning: the first ten days of Dhul Hijjah begin. small good deeds count big now. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-08.title: by the dawn
2027-05-08.line: by the dawn, and by the ten nights.
2027-05-08.meaning: many scholars say these ten nights are the ones now passing. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-09.title: say it often
2027-05-09.line: fill these days with la ilaha illallah, Allahu akbar, and alhamdulillah.
2027-05-09.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ encouraged lots of remembrance in these days. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-10.title: the call of ibrahim
2027-05-10.line: proclaim the pilgrimage to the people; they will come on foot and from every far path.
2027-05-10.meaning: Ibrahim called out, and people still answer every year. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-11.title: hajar's run
2027-05-11.line: Hajar ran seven times between the hills, searching for water for her son.
2027-05-11.meaning: pilgrims retrace her steps. a mother's faith became a rite of Hajj. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-12.title: safa and marwa
2027-05-12.line: Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah.
2027-05-12.meaning: two small hills, holy because of one woman's trust. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-13.title: here i am
2027-05-13.line: here i am, o Allah, here i am.
2027-05-13.meaning: the talbiyah, called out by pilgrims on the way. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-14.title: hearts that incline
2027-05-14.line: make the hearts of people incline toward them.
2027-05-14.meaning: Ibrahim's prayer for his family in a dry valley. today pilgrims head to Mina. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-15.title: the best day for du'a
2027-05-15.line: fasting the Day of Arafah wipes away the sins of the year before and the year after.
2027-05-15.meaning: pilgrims stand at Arafah; others fast and pray. the best du'a is the du'a of today. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-16.title: what reaches allah
2027-05-16.line: neither their meat nor their blood reaches Allah, but your devotion reaches him.
2027-05-16.meaning: Eid al-Adha remembers Ibrahim's devotion. pray, share meat with family, neighbors and the poor. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-17.title: eat and remember
2027-05-17.line: these are days of eating, drinking, and remembering Allah.
2027-05-17.meaning: the celebration continues. keep the takbir going. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-18.title: an accepted hajj
2027-05-18.line: the reward of an accepted Hajj is nothing less than paradise.
2027-05-18.meaning: pray for the pilgrims coming home. (date may vary by a day)

2027-05-19.title: the counted days
2027-05-19.line: remember Allah during the appointed days.
2027-05-19.meaning: the last of the days of tashreeq. (date may vary by a day)

2027-06-06.title: 1449 begins
2027-06-06.line: the number of months with Allah is twelve; four of them are sacred.
2027-06-06.meaning: a new Hijri year, counted from the Prophet ﷺ's journey to Madinah. Muharram is a sacred month. (date may vary by a day)

2027-06-14.title: the day before ashura
2027-06-14.line: if i live until next year, i will fast the ninth as well.
2027-06-14.meaning: many fast today and tomorrow, following the Prophet ﷺ's wish. (date may vary by a day)

2027-06-15.title: the day of musa
2027-06-15.line: the Prophet ﷺ fasted Ashura, the day Allah saved Musa.
2027-06-15.meaning: he said its fast wipes away the year before. many also remember Imam Husayn's martyrdom at Karbala today. (date may vary by a day)

2027-07-05.title: Safar begins
2027-07-05.line: there is no bad luck in Safar.
2027-07-05.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ rejected the old idea that this month was unlucky. every month is Allah's. (date may vary by a day)

2027-08-03.title: Rabi al-Awwal begins
2027-08-03.line: the month of the Prophet ﷺ's birth.
2027-08-03.meaning: many fill this month with salawat and learning about his life. (date may vary by a day)

2027-08-14.title: the best example
2027-08-14.line: in the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example.
2027-08-14.meaning: many Muslims mark the Prophet ﷺ's birth around 12 Rabi al-Awwal with salawat and stories; others don't observe it. the date varies. (date may vary by a day)

2027-09-02.title: Rabi al-Akhir begins
2027-09-02.line: a new month, a new start.
2027-09-02.meaning: the crescent is a reminder that light grows a little each night. (date may vary by a day)

2027-10-01.title: Jumada al-Ula begins
2027-10-01.line: the moons are timekeeping for people.
2027-10-01.meaning: Allah made the crescents a calendar for worship and life. (date may vary by a day)

2027-10-31.title: Jumada al-Akhirah begins
2027-10-31.line: a new Islamic month begins with the crescent.
2027-10-31.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ would say on seeing a new moon: may it bring blessing, faith, safety and peace. (date may vary by a day)

2027-11-29.title: Rajab begins
2027-11-29.line: Rajab is one of the four sacred months.
2027-11-29.meaning: a quieter month to make peace and prepare the heart. Ramadan is two months away. (date may vary by a day)

2027-12-24.title: the gift of prayer
2027-12-24.line: the five daily prayers were given on the night of the ascent.
2027-12-24.meaning: tonight, where observed, the night journey is remembered. each prayer is a small ascent. (date may vary by a day)

2027-12-29.title: Sha'ban begins
2027-12-29.line: Sha'ban is the month before Ramadan.
2027-12-29.meaning: the Prophet ﷺ fasted more in Sha'ban than any month besides Ramadan. a good time to warm up. (date may vary by a day)
